page.title: Plan and billing
page.description: Your plan, seats and AI balance. Every feature is on every plan; plans differ only in limits.
page.descriptionSelfHosted: Limits and AI for this self-hosted instance.

plan.freeSummary: 1 mailbox, 1 member and $0.50 of AI usage a month, free forever.
plan.proSummary: Unlimited mailboxes and members, $10 of AI usage per seat each month.
plan.collabSummary: Unlimited mailboxes and members, $20 of AI usage per seat each month, and your own mail with Collab.
plan.manageHint: Invoices, payment method and cancellation are in the Stripe portal.
plan.seatsHint: Owners, admins and agents each take a seat. Viewers are free.
plan.seatsNext_one: Changes to {{count}} seat at the next sync, prorated.
plan.seatsNext_other: Changes to {{count}} seats at the next sync, prorated.
plan.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change the plan.

notice.pastDueTitle: Your last payment didn't go through
notice.pastDueBody: Stripe retries automatically and you keep Pro meanwhile. Update the payment method to avoid falling back to Free.
notice.cancelBody: Nothing is deleted. After that date, adding mailboxes or members needs Pro again.
notice.confirmingBody: This usually takes a few seconds. You can keep working.

toast.proBody: Unlimited mailboxes and members, and more AI usage each month.
toast.collabBody: Connect your mail accounts from Collab.
toast.switchedBody: The change is prorated on your next invoice.
toast.topUpBody: It never expires and is spent after the monthly allowance.
toast.topUpPending: Payment received. The AI usage appears in a moment.
toast.cardSavedBody: Top-ups and auto-recharge can now charge it.
toast.confirmInCheckout: Your bank wants to confirm this payment. Opening Stripe Checkout.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to Pro
upgrade.description: Everything you have now, without the limits.

benefit.ai: $10 of AI usage per seat each month, pooled
benefit.same: The same features you use today

upgrade.secure: Payments are handled by Stripe. Cancel any time.

collab.title: Collab
collab.description: Your own mail, shared with your team: connect Google, Microsoft or IMAP accounts and work them together.
collab.freeUntil: Collab is on for free until {{date}}.
collab.freeHint: An opendesk admin turned it on for this workspace. Subscribe to keep it after it ends.
collab.freeHintForever: An opendesk admin turned it on for this workspace.

benefit.mail: Connect your own Google, Microsoft or IMAP mail
benefit.share: Keep accounts private or share them with your team
benefit.ai: $20 of AI usage per seat each month, pooled

collab.switchBody: Your subscription moves to {{price}} per seat, keeps its {{count}} seats and is prorated on the next invoice.
collab.switchBodyNoPrice: Your subscription moves to Collab, keeps its seats and is prorated on the next invoice.
collab.switchProBody: Your subscription moves back to Pro, prorated on the next invoice. Connected mail accounts stop syncing and are kept.
collab.unavailable: Collab can't be bought on this workspace yet.

limits.title: Plan limits
limits.description: What the Free plan includes. Upgrade to remove the limits.
limits.membersHint: Members and pending invitations count toward the limit.
limits.over: Over the Free limit. Everything you have stays; adding more needs Pro.

balance.title: AI balance
balance.description: AI features are paid from this balance, in US dollars. The monthly allowance resets each month; AI usage you add is spent after it and never expires.
balance.low: The AI balance is running low. AI features stop when it runs out.
balance.usageBased: Each AI call costs what it uses on the model you chose. Pricier models cost more per call.

topUp.title: Add AI usage
topUp.confirmBody: {{price}} is charged to {{card}} now. The AI usage never expires, and the invoice is under Payment method and invoices.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted: unlimited
selfHosted.body: This instance has no billing. Every workspace has unlimited mailboxes, members and AI, using the instance's own AI provider key.
selfHosted.ai: Unlimited AI with your own key

usage.title: AI usage
usage.description: AI usage in US dollars by feature, day, member and model.
usage.chartLabel: AI usage in US dollars per day, {{days}} days, stacked by feature. Use the arrow keys to read each day.
usage.empty: No AI usage in this range
usage.emptyBody: Drafts, summaries and other AI features show up here once your team uses them.
usage.unavailable: Usage reports aren't available on this instance.
usage.metered: Each call costs what it uses: longer conversations and pricier models cost more.
usage.ownKeyHint: Requests on your own provider key cost $0 here; your provider bills them.

dialog.limitTitle: You've reached a Free plan limit
dialog.balanceTitle: Your AI balance is too low
dialog.limitBody: Pro removes every limit for {{price}} per seat per month. Nothing you already have changes.
dialog.limitBodyNoPrice: Pro removes every limit. Nothing you already have changes.
dialog.balanceBody: {{remaining}} is left, not enough for this. The allowance resets on {{date}}. Add AI usage to keep going now; it never expires.
dialog.balanceBodyNoDate: There isn't enough left for this until the allowance resets. Add AI usage to keep going now; it never expires.
dialog.balancePro: On Pro, every seat adds $10 of AI usage a month.
dialog.askAdmin: Ask a workspace owner or admin to upgrade.
dialog.askAdminBalance: Ask a workspace owner or admin to add AI usage or upgrade.

errors.loadBody: Check your connection and try again.

autoRecharge.title: Auto-recharge
autoRecharge.description: Add AI usage automatically when the balance runs low, so Ollie never pauses.
autoRecharge.summary: Add {{usd}} when the balance falls below {{threshold}}, up to {{limit}} a month.
autoRecharge.thresholdHint: When the AI balance falls below this amount, add AI usage.
autoRecharge.amountHint: AI usage added each time, charged dollar for dollar.
autoRecharge.amountQuote: {{usd}} of AI usage for {{price}} each time.
autoRecharge.limitHint: Auto-recharge stops for the month once it has added this much.
autoRecharge.last: Last recharge {{date}}: {{usd}} of AI usage for {{price}}
autoRecharge.offHint: While it's off, owners and admins get a notice when the AI balance runs low and when it runs out.
autoRecharge.needCardTitle: Add a payment method to turn on auto-recharge
autoRecharge.needCardBody: Stripe keeps the card. Each recharge is charged to it with an invoice, up to your monthly limit.
autoRecharge.retryTitle: The bank declined the last recharge for now

failure.card_declined: The card was declined, so nothing was charged. Update the payment method, then turn it back on.
failure.authentication_required: The bank asked to confirm the payment, which can't happen automatically. Use another card, then turn it back on.
failure.no_payment_method: There's no saved payment method. Add one, then turn it back on.
failure.payment_failed: The payment didn't go through. Update the payment method, then turn it back on.
failure.unavailable: Adding AI usage isn't available right now. Try again later.

autoRecharge.retryToday: It's tried again at {{time}}. Auto-recharge stays on; update the payment method if the card has changed.
autoRecharge.retryLater: It's tried again {{date}} at {{time}}. Auto-recharge stays on; update the payment method if the card has changed.

banner.outTitle: The AI balance is used up.
banner.outBody: Ollie is paused: the chat agent stops answering and drafts are unavailable.
banner.lowTitle: The AI balance is running low.
banner.lowBody: {{remaining}} left. Ollie pauses when it runs out.
banner.failed: Auto-recharge turned off after a failed payment.

invoices.title: Payment method and invoices
invoices.description: The card top-ups and auto-recharge charge, and an invoice for every payment.
invoices.noCardHint: Add one to pay for AI usage in one click and to turn on auto-recharge.
invoices.expiresSoon: Expires {{date}}. Update it before a charge fails.
invoices.emptyBody: Every payment, from Pro to AI usage, gets an invoice here.
